lines.en: label soccer35:
scene gym
I make my way to the gym first thing in the morning to see what the girls are up to for soccer practice.
lines.zh: 我一大早就去体育馆，看看女生们的足球训练在搞什么。

lines.en: I immediately notice Karin leading a bunch of shorter girls in some drill that I should probably know the name of by now but can honestly just not be bothered to learn.
lines.zh: 我立刻注意到 Karin 正带着一群个子更矮的女生做什么训练——按说我这会儿早该知道那叫什么了，但说实话我懒得去学。

lines.en: Well, to be more precise, I immediately notice Karin's thighs.
lines.zh: 嗯，说得更准确点，我立刻注意到的是 Karin 的大腿。

lines.en: Everything else comes after.
lines.zh: 其他都是之后的事。

lines.en: There’s no Miku anywhere in sight, though.
lines.zh: 不过，视野里哪儿都没有 Miku。

lines.en: In fact, I don’t see Kirin anywhere either, but I guess that’s a lot more normal than having the team captain absent.
lines.zh: 事实上 Kirin 我也没看到，不过比起队长缺席，这要正常多了。

lines.en: I begin to make my way over to Karin to ask about-
lines.zh: 我开始朝 Karin 走过去，想问问——

lines.en: : Sensei! Come quick! Miku is in trouble!
lines.zh: : 老师！快来！Miku 出事了！

lines.en: : I told ya I’m fine, Kirin! Sensei, you can go back to walkin’ around the gym lookin’ at butts and stuff!
lines.zh: : 我都说我没事啦，Kirin！老师，你回去继续在体育馆里转悠看屁股什么的就行了！

lines.en: : No, no! Come over here! This is where the best butts are!
lines.zh: : 不不不！过来这边！最好的屁股在这儿！

lines.en: scene black
Being swayed by the prospect of the alleged best butts on the soccer team, I follow Kirin’s voice and wind up in front of the stage...
lines.zh: 被「足球队最好的屁股」这个前景打动，我循着 Kirin 的声音走去，最后停在了舞台前面……

lines.en: scene mikuankle1
: Sensei, quick! Miku needs mouth to mouth!
lines.zh: : 老师，快点！Miku 需要人工呼吸！

lines.en: : I don’t need friggin’ mouth to mouth for a twisted ankle...
lines.zh: : 我不过是扭了脚，才不需要他妈的人工呼吸……

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为我愿意做。

lines.en: : You should do it. Just to be safe.
lines.zh: : 你应该做一下。以防万一嘛。

lines.en: : That’s a good idea, Kirin. Please step aside.
lines.zh: : 这主意不错，Kirin。麻烦让一让。

lines.en: scene mikuankle2
: Jeez! When the heck did you two get as close as peanut butter and jelly?!
lines.zh: : 天哪！你们两个什么时候变得像花生酱和果冻这么黏糊了？！

lines.en: if kirin_virgin == False:
scene mikuankle3
: Do you want to tell her or should I do it?
lines.zh: : 你想告诉她，还是我来？

lines.en: : Tell me what? What are you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 告诉我什么？你们在说什么啊？

lines.en: : I don’t think either of us should tell her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们俩都不该告诉她。

lines.en: : Booooooring. I wanna do it.
lines.zh: : 无——聊。我想说。

lines.en: : Kirin...
lines.zh: : Kirin……

lines.en: : Sensei~
lines.zh: : 老师~

lines.en: : ...Miku?
lines.zh: : ……Miku？

lines.en: else:
scene mikuankle3
: I don’t know if I’d go as far as peanut butter and jelly...but Sensei and I have definitely been spending a decent amount of time together.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道算不算花生酱配果冻……不过我和老师确实一起待了不少时间。

lines.en: : What, for like...soccer coaching and stuff?
lines.zh: : 什么，比如……足球指导什么的？

lines.en: : You tryin’ to whip yourself into shape, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你这是想把自己练出个好身材，Kirin？

lines.en: scene mikuankle4
: Yup. He’s working me {i}really{/i} hard too. It’s a good thing I like it a little rough.
lines.zh: : 对啊。他把我操练得也{i}特别{/i}狠。幸好我还挺喜欢粗暴一点的。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m going to cut this conversation off before it has any...adverse effects on me.
lines.zh: : 好了，我得在对话对我产生任何……不良影响之前打断一下。

lines.en: : What...kinda routine does he have you on exactly?
lines.zh: : 他到底给你安排了什么样的……训练计划？

lines.en: scene mikuankle5
: Okay, moving right along- what happened to your ankle? You said you twisted it?
lines.zh: : 好了，言归正传——你的脚踝怎么了？你说扭到了？

lines.en: : Yeah. Playin’ inside is a lot different from playin’ on the grass and I came down kinda hard on it since I ain’t totally used to things in here yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯。在室内踢和草地上踢差别挺大，我还不太习惯这里，落地的时候踩得重了点。

lines.en: : And yours truly swooped in to temporarily rescue her, knowing full well that our dearest coach would soon show up to carry her to safety.
lines.zh: : 然后鄙人及时出手暂时救了她，因为我心里清楚，我们亲爱的教练很快就会出现，把她抱到安全的地方。

lines.en: : How did you know I was coming today?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我今天会来？

lines.en: : Because you always show up as soon as something interesting happens. It’s like clockwork or however the thing goes.
lines.zh: : 因为只要有有意思的事发生，你就一定会出现。跟钟表一样准，还是怎么说来着。

lines.en: : Yeah, it is kinda weird now that Kirin mentions it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，被 Kirin 这么一说，是有点怪。

lines.en: scene mikuankle6
: I’ll be totally okay, though! I just need to run to the nurse’s office for some painkillers.
lines.zh: : 不过我完全没事啦！我只要跑去保健室拿点止痛药就行。

lines.en: : Except...I can’t really run because of my ankle and...
lines.zh: : 只是……我这脚踝实在跑不了，而且……

lines.en: : You know what? Maybe I’m just doomed.
lines.zh: : 算了吧，也许我就是命该如此。

lines.en: : Sensei, maybe you should princess carry her to the nurse’s office?
lines.zh: : 老师，要不你公主抱把她抱到保健室去？

lines.en: scene mikuankle7
: No way! I watched him do that when Ayane hurt her ankle and when she came back, she was all red and...panting and stuff!
lines.zh: : 不要！Ayane 扭伤脚的时候我看他这么抱过，她回来的时候满脸通红，还……气喘吁吁什么的！

lines.en: : Oh?
: Yeah! Not sure how just carryin’ somebody can make em get all sweaty and heated, but I’ll be totally fine on my own.
lines.zh: : 对啊！我也不知道光是抱个人怎么就能让人出汗发烫，不过我自己走肯定完全没问题。

lines.en: : I can assure you that the state Ayane returned in had nothing to do with the way I carried her.
lines.zh: : 我可以保证，Ayane 回来时那副样子和我抱她的方式毫无关系。

lines.en: scene mikuankle8
: Well it sure as heck wasn’t like any ankle injury I’ve ever seen before, so explain that!
lines.zh: : 可那绝对不像我见过的任何一种脚踝伤，你倒是解释解释啊！

lines.en: : Yeah. Explain that, Sensei. We’re all dying to hear what went on with you and Ayane in the nurse’s office.
lines.zh: : 对啊。解释一下吧，老师。我们都很想听听你和 Ayane 在保健室里到底干了什么。

lines.en: : Yeah!
lines.zh: : 就是！

lines.en: : To be honest, that was so long ago now that I can’t even remember.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那都是多久以前的事了，我连记都记不清了。

lines.en: Lies. We made out behind a curtain. It was awesome.
lines.zh: 骗人。我们在帘子后面接吻了。爽翻了。

lines.en: : Anyway, talking about what happened back then won’t fix your ankle, Miku.
lines.zh: : 总之，聊那时候发生的事也治不好你的脚踝，Miku。

lines.en: : I ain’t lettin ya carry me like a heckin’ princess, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我死也不让你像公主抱那样抱我，老师！

lines.en: scene mikuankle9
: You could always just give her a piggyback ride instead. That sounds a lot less romantic, doesn’t it? Pretty sure that’s the issue here.
lines.zh: : 你也可以背她走啊。听起来就没那么浪漫了，对吧？我看问题八成就在这儿。

lines.en: : Miku, is that fine with you?
lines.zh: : Miku，这样你可以吗？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. I guess that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯……行吧。我觉得可以。

lines.en: : I had to ride on your shoulders that one time in the shed so it’s not like I’m unfamiliar with the vehicle.
lines.zh: : 之前在那间小屋里我还骑过你肩膀呢，所以我对这「载具」也不算陌生。

lines.en: : I’m a vehicle now?
lines.zh: : 我现在成了载具了？

lines.en: scene mikuankle10
: Yup! The cheapest, fastest one around!
lines.zh: : 对啊！这附近最便宜、最快的载具！

lines.en: : I want to take a ride when Miku is done.
lines.zh: : 等 Miku 用完，我也想坐一次。

lines.en: : Hop right on, Kirin! The Sensei express has enough room for everyone!
lines.zh: : 尽管上来，Kirin！老师特快号座位管够！

lines.en: : Yup. Hop right on Kirin. The real ride starts when we get to the nurse’s office.
lines.zh: : 对。上来吧 Kirin。真正的旅程到了保健室才开始。

lines.en: : Mmmmmmmmm...as much as I want to, I think I’ve gotta give this one up to Miku.
lines.zh: : 唔唔唔唔……虽然我很想，不过这次我还是让给 Miku 吧。

lines.en: : She could really use some of those good ole’ Sensei healing powers right about now.
lines.zh: : 她现在确实很需要老师那老一套的治愈之力。

lines.en: : You’ve got healing powers, Sensei?! You shoulda said somethin’! Now we don’t even have to go to the-
lines.zh: : 老师你有治愈之力？！你怎么不早说！那我们连保健室都不用去——

lines.en: : I don’t have healing powers, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我没有什么治愈之力，Miku。

lines.en: : Now hurry up and get on my back before your ankle heals on its own.
lines.zh: : 趁你脚踝还没自己长好，快点上来趴我背上。

lines.en: scene black
I lean down to let Miku jump onto my back but she wraps her legs around my neck and decides to ride my shoulders again instead.
lines.zh: 我弯下腰想让 Miku 跳到我背上，她却双腿夹住我的脖子，决定还是骑到我肩膀上。

lines.en: There will be no complaints from me regarding this situation.
lines.zh: 这种情况我可没什么好抱怨的。

lines.en: scene mikuankle11
: This is fine, right?
lines.zh: : 这样可以吧？

lines.en: : I realize it’s not a piggyback ride but I feel little bit better holdin’ onto your head than wrappin’ my arms around those big ole shoulders of yours.
lines.zh: : 我知道这不是背人，不过抓着你的脑袋，比环着你那宽宽的肩膀让我自在一点。

lines.en: : I also feel better this way.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得这样更好。

lines.en: : Have fun, you two.
lines.zh: : 你们俩玩得开心。

lines.en: : I’ll cover for you if Karin asks where you went, which she probably will because she’s a buzzkill and she sucks.
lines.zh: : 要是 Karin 问你们去哪儿了，我帮你们打掩护——她肯定会问，因为她就是个扫兴鬼，烦死了。

lines.en: : No worries, Kirin! We won’t be gone long!
lines.zh: : 别担心，Kirin！我们很快回来！

lines.en: : Cause even though Ayane came back all red and sweaty that one time, her ankle was totally fine!
lines.zh: : 因为虽然 Ayane 那次回来又红又出汗，她的脚踝可完全好了！

lines.en: : And I’m a lot more fit than she is so I’m sure Sensei can do the same thing for me.
lines.zh: : 而且我比她结实多了，所以老师肯定也能对我做一样的事。

lines.en: : Yup. Definitely can.
lines.zh: : 嗯。绝对能。

lines.en: : ...Right.
scene black
Having Miku on my shoulders makes it rather complicated walking through the halls of the[school].
lines.zh: Miku 骑在我肩膀上，让我穿过[school]走廊变得相当麻烦。

lines.en: Doors are a completely separate ordeal, and Miku seems entirely unwilling to help from atop her throne, so I need to bend down and nearly break my back just to get through some of them.
lines.zh: 门又是另一回事，而 Miku 似乎完全不愿从她的王座上搭把手，所以为了过某些门，我得弯下腰，差点把腰给折断。

lines.en: But, after a few minutes of pain that will likely force me into taking some of whatever Miku plans on taking to fix her ankle, we wind up at the nurse's office.
lines.zh: 不过，在几分钟的痛苦之后——痛到我很可能也得吃点 Miku 打算用来治脚踝的那玩意儿——我们总算到了保健室。

lines.en: Unfortunately, Miku hops off right away, so I don’t have a chance to drop her on the bed like I did with Ayane.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，Miku 立刻就跳下来了，所以我没机会像对 Ayane 那样把她扔到床上。

lines.en: I guess today is going to be a bad day after all.
lines.zh: 看来今天终究会是个糟糕的日子。

lines.en: scene mikuankle12
Miku slowly limps her way over to a table holding a bunch of different bottles on the far side of the room as if she’s done it a million times before.
lines.zh: Miku 一瘸一拐地慢慢挪到房间另一头那张摆着一堆瓶瓶罐罐的桌子边，熟练得像做过一百万次似的。

lines.en: It would probably make sense for the soccer team to have their own stash of this stuff, but I guess there might be some issues that arise by providing full pharmaceutical access to a bunch of [teens].
lines.zh: 足球队自己囤点这类东西倒也合理，不过我想，把完整的药品获取权交给一群[teens]，大概会出点问题。

lines.en: : Sorry to make ya carry me all the way here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你一路把我背过来，老师。

lines.en: : I normally bring some weaker stuff with me but I forgot to refill my bottle before comin’ to practice this morning.
lines.zh: : 我平时会随身带点药效弱些的，不过今天早上来训练前忘了把瓶子补满。

lines.en: Oh. Well I guess Miku normally {i}does{/i} have full pharmaceutical access and I was wrong.
lines.zh: 哦。看来 Miku 平时{i}确实{/i}有完整的药品获取权，是我错了。

lines.en: : Do you...have an addiction you want to talk about, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你……有什么想谈谈的药物依赖吗，Miku？

lines.en: scene mikuankle13
: What? Course not. It’s not anythin’ like that.
lines.zh: : 什么？当然没有。才不是那么回事。

lines.en: : I rarely ever get hurt during practice. I normally just keep ‘em around in case of headaches or if one of the other girls gets hurt.
lines.zh: : 我训练时很少受伤。平时带着只是以防头疼，或者其他女生受伤的时候用。

lines.en: : Is that normal?
lines.zh: : 这正常吗？

lines.en: : Course it is. Ya think those bags that girls are always carryin’ around are just filled with rainbows and sunshine or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 当然正常。你以为女生们整天背的那些包里装的全是彩虹和阳光什么的吗？

lines.en: : Well that would certainly be more exciting than Loxonin or Eve.
lines.zh: : 那可比 Loxonin 或者 Eve 刺激多了。

lines.en: : Yeah but a rainbow’s not gonna make your head stop hurtin’ so you should be proud of me for bein’ so prepared.
lines.zh: : 是呀，可彩虹又不能让你头不疼，所以你该为我准备得这么周全感到骄傲。

lines.en: : If you were prepared, you would have remembered to refill your personal bottle.
lines.zh: : 你要是真周全，就该记得把你的小药瓶补满。

lines.en: scene mikuankle14
: Uh...well...yeah. I guess you’re right.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧……嗯。你说得对。

lines.en: scene mikuankle15
: So...uhh...I guess that’s all we needed to come here for.
lines.zh: : 那……呃……我想我们来这儿要办的事就是这些了。

lines.en: : We can probably...get goin’ now.
lines.zh: : 我们大概……可以走了吧。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want me to use my miracle cure on you?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想让我用我的神奇疗法吗？

lines.en: : Do you...actually have one or...is that just a thing you’re sayin’ to try and get all touchy with me again?
lines.zh: : 你……真有那种疗法吗……还是说你只是想找个借口再对我动手动脚？

lines.en: : Woah. Since when are you this perceptive?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你什么时候变得这么敏锐了？

lines.en: scene mikuankle16
: I’m a woman now, Sensei! I’ve seen the light!
lines.zh: : 我现在是个女人了，老师！我见过世面了！

lines.en: : Well...felt the light when I sat on your lap that one time!
lines.zh: : 那个……我那次坐在你腿上的时候摸到过！

lines.en: : But I’m not allowed to talk about that!
lines.zh: : 不过他们不让我说这件事！

lines.en: : And a woman knows when she’s about to be duped!
lines.zh: : 而且女人是能察觉到自己要被骗的！

lines.en: : And yet that “woman” willingly rode my shoulders all the way here.
lines.zh: : 可这位「女人」还是心甘情愿地骑在我肩膀上，一路到了这儿。

lines.en: : I did what I had to do to fix my ankle! Gotta be crafty to survive sometimes!
lines.zh: : 我那是为了治脚踝才不得不做的！有时候为了活下去就得使点手段！

lines.en: : That’s what Kirin always tells me at least!
lines.zh: : 至少 Kirin 一直是这么跟我说的！

lines.en: : Kirin probably isn’t the best role model for you, Miku.
lines.zh: : Kirin 大概不是你最好的榜样，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikuankle17
: I keep hearin’ people say stuff like that about her, but I’ve never felt that way at all.
lines.zh: : 我老听别人这么说她，可我从来没这么觉得过。

lines.en: : I don’t get it. She’s always so nice to me.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。她对我一直都很好啊。

lines.en: : Well that’s probably just because you’re her friend.
lines.zh: : 那大概只是因为你是她的朋友。

lines.en: : She’s got lots of friends, though. Like everybody in the class is friends with her.
lines.zh: : 可她朋友很多啊。班上每个人都跟她是朋友。

lines.en: : Friends or “friends?”
lines.zh: : 朋友，还是「朋友」？

lines.en: : What? The heck is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 啥？你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : Aren’t there people who you call your friend despite never really spending time with them?
lines.zh: : 难道你没有那种嘴上叫朋友、其实压根儿不怎么一起玩的人吗？

lines.en: : I guess so, but they’re still my friends.
lines.zh: : 大概有吧，可他们还是我的朋友啊。

lines.en: : I’d never call somebody that if I don’t feel that way. Friendship’s a big thing, Sensei. It’s a dog-eating world out there.
lines.zh: : 我要是没那份心，就绝不会那么叫人。友情是很重要的事，老师。这世道可是狗吃人的世界。

lines.en: : I...think you meant to say “dog eat dog,” but I don’t want to sidetrack this conversation.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你想说的是「人吃人」（dog eat dog），不过我就不跑题了。

lines.en: : I’m sure Kirin has a lot of “friends,” but you seem to be one of the few she genuinely cares about.
lines.zh: : Kirin 肯定有很多「朋友」，但你似乎是她真正在乎的少数几个之一。

lines.en: : So you probably don’t understand what people say about her because it’s never applied to you.
lines.zh: : 所以你大概理解不了别人对她的那些评价，因为那些话从来没落到你身上。

lines.en: scene mikuankle18
: Yeah, Makoto said somethin’ similar. Just kinda hurts to hear when I know that deep down she ain’t all that bad.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Makoto 也说过类似的话。只是我心里清楚她骨子里没那么坏，听着还是会有点难受。

lines.en: : Well, on the bright side, her being in the class now will give her plenty of time to show that side of herself to everyone.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，她现在进了我们班，会有大把时间向大家展示她那一面。

lines.en: Which I can almost guarantee she will {i}not{/i} do based on my experience with her.
lines.zh: 而根据我跟她打交道的经验，这事我几乎可以保证她{i}不会{/i}做。

lines.en: scene mikuankle19
: Yeah...
: It’s still kinda crazy she wound up in our class, huh?
lines.zh: : 她最后分到我们班，还是挺离谱的吧？

lines.en: : Not really. The way she talked about it made it seem like she was going to make that happen no matter what.
lines.zh: : 其实也不。听她那口气，不管怎样她都要把这事办成。

lines.en: : Class in general has just been...all sorts of crazy lately.
lines.zh: : 总之最近班上……各种离谱。

lines.en: : Specially with that roommate of hers showin’ up.
lines.zh: : 尤其是她那个室友也冒出来了。

lines.en: : Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko？

lines.en: : Yeah, that one.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是她。

lines.en: : You...uhh...
: You’re...really popular with all sorts of girls, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……真的很受各种各样的女生欢迎啊？

lines.en: : If you’re worried about Noriko stealing me away from the rest of you, don’t be.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心 Noriko 会把我从你们这儿抢走，大可不必。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be me if I didn’t equally distribute my incredibly valuable time among all of you girls.
lines.zh: : 要是我不能把我那极其宝贵的时间平均分配给你们这些女生，那我就不是我了。

lines.en: scene mikuankle20
: It’s not really me I’m worried about...
lines.zh: : 我担心的其实不是我自己……

lines.en: : Makoto’s been gettin’ all sorts of down about stuff lately and I...don’t want more girls showin’ up to stress her out even more, ya know?
lines.zh: : Makoto 最近因为各种事一直很低落，我……不想再有更多女生冒出来让她压力更大了，你懂吧？

lines.en: : She works suuuuuper hard. And she’s really beautiful and so smart and-
lines.zh: : 她超——级努力。而且她特别漂亮，又特别聪明，还有——

lines.en: : Did she pay you to talk her up again?
lines.zh: : 又是她花钱让你这么吹她的？

lines.en: I’ve gotta hand it to Makoto. She’s definitely determined, if not anything else.
lines.zh: 我得承认 Makoto 这点——就算别的没有，她那股执着是真足。

lines.en: : Listen, if Makoto wants to talk about things like that, she can talk to me herself.
lines.zh: : 听着，如果 Makoto 想谈这种事，她可以自己来跟我谈。

lines.en: : And if {i}you{/i} want to talk to me about things like that, the same goes for you.
lines.zh: : 如果是{i}你{/i}想跟我谈这种事，也一样。

lines.en: : But I’m not going to let you act like a middleman who's out to gauge my relationships with some of the new girls for profit.
lines.zh: : 但我不会让你充当一个中间人，为了赚钱来打探我和那些新来的女生是什么关系。

lines.en: scene mikuankle21
: It’s...it’s not just for profit! I’m curious too!
lines.zh: : 才……才不只是为了赚钱！我自己也好奇啊！

lines.en: : We got a maid, a green haired girl who won’t talk to anybody, and a punk lookin’ girl who wants to have your babies! It’s weird!
lines.zh: : 我们班多了个女仆、一个跟谁都不说话的绿头发女生，还有一个想给你生孩子的朋克妹！太怪了！

lines.en: : Course I’m gonna wanna ask about them when you’re treatin’ em the same way ya treat all of us!
lines.zh: : 你对她们跟对我们一模一样，我当然想问个清楚啊！

lines.en: : More girls means less time for you and me to go runnin’ and stuff like that!
lines.zh: : 女生越多，就意味着你和我去跑步什么的時間越少！

lines.en: : And less time for you to consider buyin’ a ring and tellin’ Makoto to be your-
lines.zh: : 也意味着你越少时间去考虑买个戒指，然后跟 Makoto 说让她做你的——

lines.en: : Miku...
lines.zh: : Miku……

lines.en: scene mikuankle22
: Darn it!
lines.zh: : 可恶！

lines.en: : How’s a girl supposed to make any cash when she can’t even hype up her BFF?
lines.zh: : 一个女生连给自己最好的朋友吹捧几句都不行，还怎么赚钱啊？

lines.en: : Just tell her you followed through, it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 你就跟她说你办成了，没事的。

lines.en: : I can’t heckin’ lie to Makoto, Sensei! She’s Makoto!
lines.zh: : 我不能对 Makoto 撒谎啊，老师！她可是 Makoto！

lines.en: : She’ll see through me like a friggin’ window!
lines.zh: : 她会像看窗户玻璃一样把我看穿的！

lines.en: : Well then I suppose it’s time for you to start looking for a real job.
lines.zh: : 那么我看你是时候去找份正经工作了。

lines.en: : The heck kinda job is someone like me gonna do?
lines.zh: : 我这样的人能干个什么鬼工作啊？

lines.en: : I don’t know. What are you good at besides soccer?
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。除了足球你还擅长什么？

lines.en: : You...have any messages that need to be delivered?
lines.zh: : 你……有什么需要传的话吗？

lines.en: scene black
I leave a message with Miku to give to Makoto, but quickly retract it once I remember that I’m supposed to pay her.
lines.zh: 我托 Miku 给 Makoto 带句话，但一想起我本来该付她钱，就立刻收回了。

lines.en: Miku lives the rest of her life unemployed and dies alone and poor.
lines.zh: Miku 从此失业一生，孤独贫穷地死去。

lines.en: The end.
lines.zh: 完。

lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}
